body.title: Story commits and changed files
body.summary: Move story-commits.ts (git(), scanTrailers, newestStoryCommit, storyChangeSet, mergeInProgress) onto git_log, git_rev_list, git_rev_parse, git_hash_object, git_diff_tree, git_diff, git_merge_tree and the gitPath input built in t2, and change changed-files.ts collectDiff to callTool(gitDiffTool, ...) instead of execute. The functions become async and their callers await.
acceptanceChecks: build-runners-registry.test.ts covers the Story change set on real repositories including a merge commit, a squash and an empty Story
build-runners-parity.test.ts shows storyChangeSet and mergeInProgress equal the old results
collectDiff runs through the executor (a declined approval fails the stage)

tests.name: build-runners-registry.test.ts: storyChangeSet, newestStoryCommit, mergeInProgress and collectDiff run through the registry including a merge commit, a squash and an empty Story
build-runners-parity.test.ts: storyChangeSet and mergeInProgress equal the old results
